reviews.title: DO NOT SUBSCRIBE!
reviews.text: I started a free trial and used it for a day and the calorie tracker seemed to work just fine so I jumped onto the “promotional” opportunity to subscribe for a year for $14.99. Then very conveniently the bar code scanner has yet to work on any barcode since. I’ve messaged support and they didn’t have any helpful resolutions besides waste more time sending them screenshots of an app that doesn’t work? Please save your money and use any other app besides Calz.

reviews.title: It feels like I’m training the AI for free.
reviews.text: The app looks nice and is user-friendly, so I decided to try it to save time, but it’s doing the opposite. It can’t detect food correctly, especially when there are more than three ingredients on the plate. It keeps making mistakes even after I correct them it really feels like I’m constantly retraining the AI, and it still gets things wrong.

reviews.title: My Nutrition Data
reviews.text: It’s surprising that an app focused on calorie and nutrition tracking doesn’t share that data with the Apple Health App. Most people expect to use that information across multiple apps to get a full picture of their health. Adding this integration would make the app far more valuable and practical.
